titulo: Off-duty police officer detains man who attacked three women with knives in Paris
cuerpo: Two women severely wounded before bystanders intervened in incident near Porte de Clichy A man attacked three women with knives in Paris before bystanders pinned him to the ground and an off-duty police officer detained him, the French interior ⁠minister, Laurent Nuñez, has said. The man attacked the three women, aged 19, 24 and 36, with ⁠two kitchen knives, severely wounding two of them, near Porte de Clichy on Monday, Nuñez said. Continue reading...
